full_details: On the Bishopsgate post there were two fresh bills: the Rose reopens with The French Doctor, and your company opens the Theatre with the comedy. At the Theatre, James Burbage counted the early yard as timber and gave no number. The white swan was for noon and the trumpet for two. The stage is twice the breadth of the Cross Keys. Sam sang, and nobody told him of any other plan. You played Navarre. After the play the hush at the messenger was a house of two thousand, and Margery Pell had fifty-two shillings in her box. At home the ink had been boiling. You copied the two lines you already had, and you did not begin the quarrel again.
one_sentence: You read two fresh bills on the Bishopsgate post, Sam sang the cuckoo clear, and Margery Pell came down with fifty-two shillings.
title: Heard Sam clear, and fifty-two shillings from Margery Pell
